projects.title: Graphical User Interface and Database Concepts Projects
projects.description:
- Created and structured a backend SQL database that was deployed on AWS
- Designed a frontend web application connected to a similar database using the REACT framework
- Collaborated with five other students to deliver a professional web application using the Agile Development process

projects.title: Data Structures
projects.description:
-	Created fundamental data structures in C++ including binary trees, queues, linked lists, stacks and priority queues
-	Developed strong algorithm analysis skills as well as object-oriented software engineering strategies 
-	Created an algorithm that performs sentiment analysis with 64% accuracy out of 20,000 tweets
-	Developed an auto indexer and complex maze algorithm using custom data structures and algorithms
-	Implemented complex algorithms associated with our data structures such as iterative backtracking
-	Designed and built a reverse-indexed binary search tree search engine that utilized data sets of around 12,000 files
